name: canon
description: Strict conventions enforcing the latest official APIs across Vue 3.5, Nuxt UI v4, Tailwind v4, TypeScript, Go Echo v5 + sqlc, Node Fastify v5, PostgreSQL schema + migrations, and Astro. Framework skills auto-activate by file path, plus two manual workflow commands (/canon:go, /canon:cm) that trigger only on demand. Forbids deprecated patterns (<style scoped>, any, @ts-ignore, bg-opacity-*, bare DROP TABLE, single-shot ALTER TABLE ... NOT NULL); forces current best practices (<script setup> + defineModel, oklch() colors, Echo HTTPErrorHandler, sqlc generated Querier, three-step NOT NULL migrations, client:visible / server:defer).
